unit.why: This is a homiletic exegesis of Genesis 46 (Vayigash) about the levels of Yaakov and Yisrael and exile. It is transmitted in the name of the author's father, his teacher and R. Yerahmiel of Przysucha, and it has no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: the teaching breaks off mid-sentence ('ורק ישראל לעשות') and likely continues past the footnote in the next division
